```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

theme_tigit <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e6ebf0", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#17202a"),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

indicators <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/municipal-indicators-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

## Ajust lineal i mètriques per anotar la fórmula i el coeficient de determinació.
mod <- lm(population_total ~ housing_total, data = indicators)
r2 <- summary(mod)$r.squared
b0 <- coef(mod)[1]
b1 <- coef(mod)[2]

## funció senzilla per formatar nombres (punt com a separador de milers)
fmt_num <- function(x) {
  s <- formatC(round(x, 1), format = "f", big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", digits = 1)
  s
}

etiqueta <- sprintf(
  "%s\n%s",
  sprintf("població = %s + %s·habitatges", fmt_num(b0), fmt_num(b1)),
  sprintf("R² = %s", format(round(r2, 2), decimal.mark = ","))
)

fig <- ggplot(indicators, aes(x = housing_total, y = population_total)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#b2182b", fill = "#b2182b", alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(color = "#2171b5", size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(indicators$housing_total) * 0.98,
    y = max(indicators$population_total) * 0.99,
    label = etiqueta,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.4,
    color = "#17202a"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Habitatges i població als municipis del Tarragonès (2021)",
    x = "Habitatges totals",
    y = "Població total",
    caption = "L'associació és alta (R² = 0,93), però això no la converteix en una relació causal provada. Font: Idescat, cens de 2021 i habitatges per tipus d'habitatge, 2021."
  ) +
  theme_tigit()

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/housing-population-scatter-tarragones-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 8, height = 5.5, device = svglite::svglite)
```

Una associació forta no implica causalitat; només quantifica com varien juntes dues variables.")
